load_model_from_checkpoint: load a pretrained DUSt3R model from a checkpoint file path onto a specified device
instantiate_AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo: create an AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo model with configurable output mode, head type, depth mode, and confidence mode
load_pretrained_AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo: load a pretrained AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo model from a Hugging Face hub repo or local checkpoint file
instantiate_AsymmetricCroCo3DStereoMulti: create an AsymmetricCroCo3DStereoMultiView model with optional Gaussian Splatting head and multiple reference view support
run_forward_two_view_stereo: run forward pass on AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo with two view dictionaries to predict 3D points in view1 frame
